instruction: Look at freecad_task-10_input.step in FreeCAD. For this task, launch FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad` and open `freecad_task-10_input.step` there. Use the Part Design workbench for the modeling operations; activate or create the relevant Body, create new sketches for sketch-based features, and use feature or placement tools for the requested edits. In the annular ring, cut a rectangular side notch on the +X side. The notch is 18 mm wide along Y, extends from X=20 mm to X=40 mm, and cuts through the full 8 mm thickness. Preserve the center hole and remaining ring geometry. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-10_output.step.
